operations.description:
Exports are generated asynchronously within SlideRoom.  To retrieve the export file generated by this request, use the api/v#/export/{token} endpoint to check the progress/result of the generation process.
PDF and ZIP exports are available in the Advanced Plan.
operations.summary: Requests the generation of application export files (tabular, pdf, zip).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] application request export [PATH] application request export [PARAMS] account app applicant attachments comments common delivery email export folder format forms full highlights include media name organization original page pdf pool ratings references round search since status tab type zip [SCHEMA] application export request result
